---
name: rehearse-talk
description: Review the entire talk's speaker notes, calculate delivery pacing, and provide constructive stage feedback.
agent: slide-architect
---

Act as my executive speech coach for this conference talk.

Load the speaker-coach skill and read the talk's `talk.md` for its target duration.

1. Read through all slides in the `talks/<talk-name>/slides/` folders.
2. Calculate estimated total speaking time based on speaker notes word count (~130 words per minute).
3. Identify any slides that are too dense, lack stage direction, or have awkward transitions.
4. Suggest where to pause, ask rhetorical questions, or use the blackout (`B`) key to regain audience eye contact.
